argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$work='E:\PC-Control\Proxifier-Avito-20261012'
[System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($work)|Out-Null
$body=@'
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$dir=Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$original=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Proxifier4\Profiles\Default.ppx'
$backup=Join-Path $dir 'Default-original-backup.ppx'
$staged=Join-Path $dir 'SecondChrome-Direct-PIDs.ppx'
$proxifier='C:\Program Files (x86)\Proxifier\Proxifier.exe'
if(!(Test-Path $original) -or !(Test-Path $proxifier)){throw 'Missing Proxifier installation or Default profile'}
if(!(Test-Path $backup)){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $original -Destination $backup -ErrorAction Stop}
if((Get-FileHash $original).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash $backup).Hash){throw 'Proxifier profile has changed since the backup; refusing to alter it. Review manually.'}
$running=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='chrome.exe'")
$roots=@($running|Where-Object{([string]$_.CommandLine -notmatch '--type=')})
$primary=@($roots|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -match '--remote-debugging-port=17410'})
$second=@($roots|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -notmatch '--remote-debugging-port'})
if($primary.Count -ne 1 -or $second.Count -ne 1){throw 'Could not uniquely identify first Chrome CDP 17410 and second Chrome. No changes made.'}
$ids=@([int]$second[0].ProcessId)+@($running|Where-Object{$_.ParentProcessId -eq $second[0].ProcessId}|Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId)
$ids=@($ids|Sort-Object -Unique)
if($primary[0].ProcessId -in $ids){throw 'Main Chrome PID in direct list: aborted'}
$raw=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($original,[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
$m=[regex]::Match($raw,'<RuleList(?:\s[^>]*)?>')
if(!$m.Success -or [regex]::Matches($raw,'<RuleList(?:\s[^>]*)?>').Count -ne 1){throw 'Unexpected Proxifier profile format'}
$apps=($ids|ForEach-Object{"pid=$_"}) -join ';'
$rule=([Environment]::NewLine)+'    <Rule enabled="true">'+([Environment]::NewLine)+'      <Action type="Direct" />'+([Environment]::NewLine)+'      <Applications>'+$apps+'</Applications>'+([Environment]::NewLine)+'      <Name>Second Chrome DIRECT [session]</Name>'+([Environment]::NewLine)+'    </Rule>'
$new=$raw.Insert($m.Index+$m.Length,$rule)
[xml]$baseXml=$raw
[xml]$newXml=$new
foreach($tag in @('Options','ProxyList','ChainList')){if($baseXml.DocumentElement.SelectSingleNode($tag).OuterXml -cne $newXml.DocumentElement.SelectSingleNode($tag).OuterXml){throw "Unexpected change in $tag"}}
if($new.Replace($rule,'') -cne $raw){throw 'Unexpected profile diff'}
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($staged,$new,[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$p=Start-Process -FilePath $proxifier -ArgumentList ('"'+$staged+'" silent-load') -PassThru -Wait
if($p.ExitCode -ne 0){throw "Proxifier profile load failed: $($p.ExitCode)"}
Write-Host "DIRECT enabled ONLY for second Chrome, PID $($second[0].ProcessId), and its existing children. Main Chrome remains proxied."
Write-Host "After restarting second Chrome, run this launcher again."
'@
$script=Join-Path $work 'REFRESH_SECOND_CHROME_DIRECT.ps1'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($script,$body,[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$launcher=Join-Path $work 'START_SECOND_CHROME_DIRECT.cmd'
$cmd='@echo off'+[Environment]::NewLine+'powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0REFRESH_SECOND_CHROME_DIRECT.ps1"'+[Environment]::NewLine+'echo.'+[Environment]::NewLine+'pause'+[Environment]::NewLine
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($launcher,$cmd,[System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
$t=$null;$errs=$null
[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($script,[ref]$t,[ref]$errs)|Out-Null
[ordered]@{scriptPath=$script;launcherPath=$launcher;parserErrorCount=@($errs).Count;existingProxifierAndChromeProcessesUntouched=$true;doesNotAutoRun=$true;profileOverwriteNotPerformed=$true}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
